name: Wanjiku's Kitchen Garden
description: Tender sukuma wiki, managu, terere and other leafy greens cultivated in the cool Central Highlands just outside Nairobi.

name: Rift Valley Grains
description: Small-batch milled grains and staples rooted in the fertile highland plains and Swahili coastal pantry traditions.

name: Ngong Hills Blooms
description: Fresh-cut stems and King Protea arrangements shaped by the cool breeze and rich soils of the Ngong escarpment.

name: Mama Akinyi Preserves
description: Sun-ripened passion fruit jam and coastal fruit preserves made with citrus, ginger and sweet-spiced Swahili flavour.

name: Kiambu Valley Farm
description: Avocados, nduma and root vegetables grown in the misty Central Highlands with careful soil stewardship and rain-fed farming.

name: Zawadi Patisserie
description: Wimbi sourdough and mkate wa sinia shaped by Kenyan bakery traditions and the warm, welcoming flavours of tea-time tables.
